## 🎯 What's New in v2.0.3

### ✨ Major Features

#### 🎯 Improved Prediction Algorithm
- Multi-factor analysis using up to 21 sessions
- Day-of-week pattern detection with consistency scoring
- Time-of-day preference analysis (morning/afternoon/evening/night)
- Confidence indicators: 🎯 High (80%+), 📊 Medium (60-80%), 🔮 Low (<60%)
- Weighted recent sessions (85% exponential decay)
- Smart fallback when patterns are weak

#### ⏱️ Synchronized Notification Timer
- Live timer updates every 10 seconds in notification
- Shows elapsed time in MM:SS format
- "Finish Session" button directly in notification
- Opens app to questions screen when tapped
- Automatically dismisses when session ends
- Replaces floating timer for cleaner UI

#### 🔄 Check for Updates Feature
- Automatic version checking from GitHub releases
- Compares current version with latest release
- Direct APK download from GitHub
- User-friendly update prompts
- Replaces "Reset to Demo Data" in Settings

#### 📊 Dynamic Status Messages
- Real-time activity tracking on home screen
- Personalized messages based on actual data:
  - "Your rhythm is steady today"
  - "More active than usual today"
  - "Consistent daily rhythm"
  - "No activity in 2+ days"
- Tracking consistency scoring (90%+ = Excellent)
- Contextual subtitles with session counts

#### 📸 Weekly Wrapped Improvements
- Fixed text cutoff issues (no more "Smoo th")
- New "Save to Gallery" feature
- Better card sizing and layout
- 1080x1920 Instagram Story format
- Improved font sizing and centering
- Two export options: Share or Save

#### 📦 15 Days Demo Data
- Comprehensive sample data for new users
- 20 bowel movement sessions across 15 days
- Varied stool types, durations, and patterns
- 15 days of daily health records
- Realistic correlations and insights
- Automatically removed when user enters real data

### 🔧 Improvements

- **Prediction Accuracy**: Now analyzes 21 sessions vs 14 previously
- **Pattern Detection**: Detects day-of-week and time-of-day patterns
- **Consistency Scoring**: Measures how predictable patterns are
- **Card Layouts**: Better sizing prevents text overflow
- **Notification UX**: Timer syncs perfectly with app state
- **Data Insights**: More accurate correlations and recommendations
- **Performance**: Optimized with React.memo and useCallback
- **Animations**: Smooth spring animations with native driver

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed Weekly Wrapped text wrapping issues
- Fixed notification timer synchronization
- Removed floating timer (notification-based now)
- Removed daily health popup (available in home screen)
- Fixed package version conflicts with Expo SDK 55
- Fixed card sizing in Weekly Wrapped export
- Improved text centering and alignment

### 🗑️ Removed

- Floating timer component (replaced with notification)
- Daily health modal popup (still accessible in home screen)
- Auto-update check on startup (manual check in Settings)
- Reset to demo data button (replaced with update checker)

---

## 📥 Installation

### New Installation
1. Download `bowels-v2.0.3.apk` from Assets below
2. Enable "Install from Unknown Sources" in Android settings
3. Open the downloaded APK file
4. Tap "Install"
5. Open the app and start tracking!

### Updating from Previous Version
1. Download `bowels-v2.0.3.apk` from Assets below
2. Install over your existing app
3. Your data will be preserved automatically
4. New features available immediately

---

## 📱 Requirements

- **Android**: 5.0 (Lollipop) or higher
- **Storage**: 50 MB free space
- **Permissions**: 
  - Notifications (for session timer)
  - Storage (for Weekly Wrapped export)
  - Internet (for update checks)
